answer.value: Mid-fusion multimodal architecture: Phi-4-Reasoning language model backbone plus SigLIP-2 vision encoder, with visual tokens projected into the language model's embedding space; dynamic resolution vision encoder with up to 3,600 visual tokens and intra-image bidirectional attention.
quotes: Phi-4-Reasoning-Vision-15B is a compact open-weight multimodal reasoning model built on the Phi-4-Reasoning language model backbone and the SigLIP-2 vision encoder, using a mid-fusion architecture.
In this architecture, the vision encoder first converts images into visual tokens, which are then projected into the language model's embedding space and injected into the pretrained language model.

The model employs a dynamic resolution vision encoder with up to 3,600 visual tokens, enabling high-resolution image understanding critical for tasks such as GUI grounding and fine-grained document analysis.
Bidirectional attention is applied within images (intra-image) to improve spatial reasoning without the overfitting risks observed with broader bidirectional schemes.
